items.headline: Unichain schedules its next upgrade
items.what_happened: Uniswap Labs says Unichain will move to OP Enterprise, with testnet migration on 13 October and mainnet on 29 October.
items.why_it_matters: The move prepares Unichain for native transfers between OP Stack chains. Existing contracts, balances and Uniswap deployments stay the same.
items.risk: Native interoperability is still to come. The announcement does not quantify extra revenue or token-holder benefit from this upgrade.

items.headline: Chainlink opens a simpler route into DeFi vaults
items.what_happened: Chainlink says its CCIP Vault Adapters are live, letting vaults accept deposits from more than 80 supported blockchains. Aave is among the adopters.
items.why_it_matters: Vault providers can reach users on other chains while keeping the vault and its accounting on one home chain.
items.risk: The announcement does not quantify new fees or LINK demand. Vault strategy, smart-contract and cross-chain risks remain.
